== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Expands exclusion penalty beyond your turn. Replaces random Lost Pile selection and stacking with retrieve 1, removes free X relocation. Specifies opponent did not initiate a battle rather than did not battle. Control two battlegrounds and opponent deployed a card with ability remain.
